name: Universal Intermodal Services - Harvey Terminal - Harvey IL

fieldNotes.siteResolution: LOW CONFIDENCE — operating yard not positively confirmed. No street address in roster; the ULH 2025 10-K names Harvey IL as an owned terminal/yard property in the Chicago rail-ramp corridor. The loadmatch intermodal directory and a LoopNet property record list Universal Intermodal Services' Harvey location at 250 E 167th St, Harvey IL 60426. That address geocoded to 41.5865, -87.6403; satellite + Street View at that point show an older brick industrial building with a small chain-link-fenced paved lot on a mixed residential/industrial block of 167th St — no truck docks, trailer yard, or visible drayage operation. This appears to be a registered/mailing address rather than an active operating drayage yard. The CN Harvey (CN Gateway) intermodal rail ramp at 16800 S Center St is the area's gravity center; Universal Intermodal's actual Harvey drayage terminal/yard could not be positively located in imagery.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No gate/guard booth observed at the 250 E 167th St brick building; small open fenced lot only. Classed false at low confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth observed. false (low confidence).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: The brick building showed 1-2 freight doors; no regular dock rhythm. 0-10 / low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No trailer-storage lot observed at the geocoded address; classed false at low confidence — the actual drayage yard (with chassis/trailer storage) is presumed elsewhere in the CN Harvey corridor but not located.
